enemy-051-ceto-reef-predator.reviewer: Codex level_props_audit_fix V75 independent manual review
enemy-051-ceto-reef-predator.method: All32 source thoracic points and eight corpse support planes were manually read on unchanged native sources, plotted and visually checked. Living roots use the observed thorax plus72px ventral datum, preserving paddling and tail motion; not bbox centering, bottom alignment or planted feet. Corpse roots independently use lower paddle/body substrate planes to retain collapse.
